title: Imaginary Root
drugs: dextromethorphan, caffeine, amantadine, dimenhydrinate, compound licorice tablets, fluvoxamine

segments.label: RP-7-1
segments.summary: My first od. ... I woke as if just over a fever.

segments.label: RP-7-9
segments.summary: The trip through hell. Unconscious and unrousable. The heavy sleep lasted four days.

segments.label: RP-7-12
segments.summary: Suicide felt so meaningless. Suddenly I didn't want to die; I wanted to live properly.

segments.label: RP-7-13
segments.summary: Reproduction failed. Extremely forgetful; depressed enough that a single lick of salt would have finished it.

segments.label: RP-7-26
segments.summary: The last od. This failure was hard to avoid, but at least we weathered the loss.

segments.label: RP-7-27
segments.summary: A chronicle of twenty-six times. He was cataloguing his own abyss.

segments.label: RP-7-28
segments.summary: The chronicle of twenty-six is finished; he stops on the last page.
